subject: Allow user to download an existing file already sitting in the working directory

messages.author: f912724b32d84d06
messages.subject: Allow user to download an existing file already sitting in the working directory
parts:
Hello!

I have a simple function that creates one zip file in the working directory and all I need is for the user to be able to download this file. However, nothing is working and the examples on the web don't help.
It should be very simple - but I am not even sure what the problem is because I don't know how to debug the code in Shiny. I am sure my problem is in server.R section that contains this code:

    content = function(file) 
    {
      file.copy(myout(),file)
    }


Thanks a ton for your hints. It's just a shame to be stuck at such a seemingly simple task: to download an existing file!
D.

Here is my code (it's a simple, reproducible example - assuming your zip program is in PATH).

# To run:
library(shiny)
runApp(launch.browser = T)

# ui.R:

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  
  headerPanel("My App"),
  
  sidebarPanel(
    numericInput('NumRuns','Number of runs',value=3,min=3,max=10,step=1),
    br(),
    actionButton(inputId="goButton","Run!"),
    br(),
    br(),
    downloadLink('downloadData', 'Download'),
    
  ),
  
  mainPanel(
      h3(textOutput("PLACEHOLDER"))
  )
  
))

# server.R:

shinyServer(function(input,output){
  
  myout = reactive({
    if(input$goButton==0) return(NULL)
    
    nrruns=input$NumRuns   # nrruns=3
    filenames=NULL
    for(i in 1:nrruns){
      mydf<-data.frame(a=rnorm(10),b=runif(10))
      myname<-paste("dataframe",i,".csv",sep="")
      write.csv(mydf,myname,row.names=F)
      filenames=c(filenames,myname)
    }
    myzipname<-paste("csvFiles ",nrruns,".zip",sep="")   # replace with current time later
    zip(myzipname,filenames)                              # ? function that creates unique names
    return(myzipname)
  })
  
  

  output$downloadData <- downloadHandler(
    filename = myout()
    content = function(file) 
    {
      file.copy(myout(),file)
    }
  )

  
})
